about.title: About FunCuby
about.description: This project is an unofficial open-source web tool for CubyFun easyplay 1s, with Bluetooth connectivity, MIDI playback and practice.
about.star: If this project helped you, please give me a Star ⭐!

calibration.title: First-key calibration
calibration.hint: Press the physical first key to align the layout. Both keyboard views then show the pitches the device actually sends. Only the page display changes.

rxFormat.label: Receive format
rxFormat.hint: Auto prefers 80 80 packets. If timestamps and running status are ambiguous, switch to the timestamped format. Connecting only subscribes to notifications and sends no initialisation commands.

send.pitches: Pitches (decimal, separated by spaces or commas)

raw.label: One HEX packet or sleep milliseconds per line
raw.hintBefore: One packet per line, never merged and without added headers, up to 512 bytes each. A line
raw.hintAfter: waits 101 ms after the previous packet is written before running the next line; decimals allowed, 0–60000 ms. Blank lines are ignored and every line is validated before sending. “Cancel pending” aborts the wait and anything after it.

send.written: Written; this is not an acknowledgement from the device.

rawDone.one: The line-by-line send finished with {count} packet; a browser write does not mean the device executed it.
rawDone.other: The line-by-line send finished with {count} packets; a browser write does not mean the device executed them.

send.cancelled: Sends that had not started were cancelled; the write in progress will finish normally.

score.hint: Click a beat on any track to set A / B, or drag across beats to select a range. All tracks share the range, and B sits after the last selected beat. The bar fields select whole bars. Beats show onsets and held notes; the approach rings set the actual rhythm.

latency.title: Input latency calibration
latency.hint: Follow 8 approach rings on the first key and press and release as each ring closes. At least 5 hits are needed; the median timing error is used.

transcribe.title: Audio to practice score
transcribe.intro: Import an audio file or a Bilibili or YouTube link to create a pocket-piano score you can audition, export or practice. Transcription runs on this device.
transcribe.sourceHint: The file never leaves this device. MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A and other browser-decodable formats work; DRM-protected files do not.

storage.deferred: Automatic restoration was skipped to preserve your current interaction. Reopen the page and wait to restore, or import audio to begin.
storage.unsaved: Current audio is not saved yet; the previous successful save is retained
storage.saving: Saving locally; please wait before refreshing…
storage.unavailable: Could not read or write the library. Check the local server and free disk space. You can still export your edits as MIDI.
storage.conflict: Another tab replaced or deleted the saved work. This tab will not overwrite it automatically; reimport to save this song.
storage.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Saved data may still remain; please retry.
storage.clear: Delete Saved Work And Clear Song
storage.confirmClear: Delete this song, its audio, stems, clips and scores from the disk library?
storage.hint: Each song has its own folder with its source audio, available vocal stems, MIDI scores and editable draft.

transcribe.trialHint: Transcribe up to 25 seconds from the current clip start

melody.name: Melody · original rhythm
melody.desc: For listening or humming along. Play one note at a time with the melody’s phrasing and rests.

fuller.name: Detailed arrangement
fuller.desc: Practice two-note playing once you know the tune. Keep existing dyads or add a softer lower voice to individual notes.

original.name: Working melody (unadapted)
original.desc: For checking the transcription and your edits. Keeps the working pitches and timing, including notes beyond the keyboard’s range.

transcribe.analysis: Detected: ~{bpm} BPM (offset {origin} ms) · Key ~{key} (main-key fit {rawFit}% → {bestFit}% at {transpose} semitones)
transcribe.stats: Source notes {source} · arranged notes {output} · filtered out {filtered} · thinned {reduced} · octave-folded {octave} (shift {shift}) · outside 25 keys {out} · tempo {bpm} BPM
transcribe.outOfRange: {count} notes fall outside the 25-key range — download or audition only; practice is disabled.
transcribe.previewHint: Fixed numbering 1=C — not a detected key. The full rhythmic score appears on the Practice page.
transcribe.previewFix: Fix the settings above to preview the notes.
transcribe.emptyVersion: This version has no notes — try another level.
transcribe.engineBasicGuide: Use for piano, guitar or other instrumental tracks. Basic Pitch detects overlapping pitches and runs in the browser without Python.
transcribe.engineGameGuide: Use for songs with a clear lead vocal or for a quick first draft. GAME tracks singing directly from the mix, saving the time of vocal separation.
transcribe.engineGameSeparatedGuide: Use when backing instruments mask the singer or GAME misses or stretches notes. UVR isolates the vocal first to reduce interference. The extra pass takes longer.
transcribe.engineReady: Local GAME is ready. Run npm run setup:separation to enable vocal separation.
transcribe.engineSeparatedReady: Local GAME and vocal separation are ready.
transcribe.engineMissing: Browser mode is available. For local GAME, install numpy and onnxruntime, run npm run setup:game, then restart the server. Vocal separation also needs npm run setup:separation.

pipeline.title: Transcription progress
pipeline.uvrDetail: UVR converts each window to a spectrogram, extracts vocals, and reconstructs audio before joining the windows.

vocals.title: Vocals extracted by UVR
vocals.waiting: The isolated vocal clip will be ready to play after separation.
vocals.ready: Isolated vocals from {start}–{end} in the source. Some backing audio may remain.
vocals.unavailable: A vocal preview is unavailable for this run.

transcribe.auditionOriginal: Working melody · original pitch and timing

editor.title: Melody Review And Editing
editor.hint: Previous and next phrases follow rests. Adjust the clip-relative endpoints (up to 30 seconds) to loop the source, vocals or piano. Sounding piano notes light up.
editor.vocalHint: Run UVR + GAME on this clip to add isolated vocals.
editor.vocalMissing: The score is saved, but this clip’s vocal WAV is missing. Run UVR + GAME on the same clip in transcription settings to save the vocals.
editor.vocalReadError: This vocal stem could not be read. Re-run UVR + GAME for this clip.
editor.releaseDetail: Listen for a rest starting at {at} s.
editor.repeatDetail: Listen for a release at {at} s and a repeated note at {again} s.
editor.count: Showing {visible}/{total} notes; narrow the phrase for dense passages
editor.raw: No manual edits yet. A review draft is not a verified reference.
editor.edited: Manual edits feed all arrangements and working MIDI. Undo retains up to 20 steps in this editing session only.
editor.empty: No notes in this phrase. Adjust the range or add a note; silence may be a valid rest.
editor.invalidRange: Choose valid endpoints inside the clip, 0.1–30 seconds apart.
editor.invalidEdit: Invalid edit: integer pitch 0-127 and timing within the clip required. Splits need 20 ms on both sides; merges need adjacent equal pitches at most 250 ms apart.
editor.confirmReset: Restore the unedited recognizer notes? You can undo this operation; audio is unaffected.
editor.confirmClip: Switch clips? The current transcription and edits will be available under Saved clip versions.
editor.confirmRerun: Retranscribing replaces this mode's recognition and manual edits. Continue? Export the review draft first for a backup.

transcribe.assumptions: Piano audition uses local Salamander samples (Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0). Listening dynamics do not change MIDI velocities. Working melody includes manual edits; unedited recognizer MIDI is separately downloadable. BPM and 4/4 remain draft assumptions; arranged playback is not synchronized with the source.

url.label: Bilibili or YouTube video URL
url.hint: Paste a public video link. The local server downloads the audio with yt-dlp + ffmpeg — it needs internet and npm start, uses no cookies or login, and only works for content you are allowed to download. YouTube may be unreachable on some networks.

method.basic-pitch: Basic Pitch detects notes in the browser. Simplification tracks a lead line through the candidates.
